Sarcoidosis: Elevated angiotensin-converting enzyme level: 158 U/l (normal value: 20–60 U/l)
Thoracic CT scan showed mediastinal and hilar lymphadenopathia of 2–3 cm in diameter
Broncho-alveolar lavage (BAL) revealed a CD4/CD8 ratio above the normal value
Elevated soluble Interleukin2 receptor: 4133 U/ml (normal value: 220–710 U/ml)
In June 2005, the patient exhibited an inflammatory syndrome with a slightly elevated body temperature (up to 37.5°C) and general weakness
Complaints of insomnia, severe pruritus, and an unintended weight loss of 4 kg over 12 weeks
